initialization: Reconstruct the historical one-layer initial model and verify its SHA; seed extra layers with CPU-only seed+101 in a four-layer template; overwrite all one-layer parameters from the verified initial model; load nested subsets for two/four layers; no trained weights used.
rng: Restore CPU RNG after original one-layer construction; CUDA/shuffle/negative seeds unchanged; depth naturally changes subsequent ordinary dropout draw consumption, so full dropout trajectories are not claimed identical.
checkpoint_selection: overall validation NDCG@10, then HR@10, earliest epoch on ties
depth_selection: highest three-seed mean best-validation NDCG@10, then HR@10, then fewer layers
evaluation_policy: validation-only architecture development on the reused 10k cohort; no new test labels, no automatic model/index replacement
budget: same five epochs, users, batches, objective, negative policy and shared initial parameters; deeper models have more compute and different dropout draw trajectories
